security_audit.summary: All 20 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code formatting, Chinese text, or legitimate operational terminology. The file contains readable guidance, not obfuscated content, executable backticks, privilege-escalation commands, or malicious reconnaissance. However, the skill authorizes broad operational execution without mandatory approval and rollback safeguards, creating a high-impact change risk.

remediation.suggestion: Require read-only discovery first. Obtain explicit user approval before privileged, destructive, or production changes, and provide dry-run, backup, validation, and rollback steps.

semantic_findings.title: Operational Changes Lack Confirmation Guardrails
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs the agent to execute commands and infrastructure changes without requiring user confirmation, dry runs, least privilege, or rollback checks. Terraform apply and broad operational execution can modify production systems or cause outages.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The execution workflow and Terraform apply capability are explicit, while no approval gate appears in the 327-line skill.

content.value_statement: Infrastructure work spans many tools, environments, and failure modes. This skill organizes deployment, troubleshooting, automation, monitoring, validation, and documentation into practical workflows.
actual_capabilities: Creates guidance for Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, Ansible, Nginx, and CI/CD configurations.
Builds troubleshooting workflows for CPU, memory, disk, network, containers, and applications.
Designs Prometheus collection, Grafana dashboards, logging pipelines, and alert rules.
Plans backup, disaster recovery, certificate, key rotation, and security baseline tasks.
Produces change records, incident reports, architecture diagrams, and validation checklists.
limitations: Requires access to the target environment and compatible operational tools.
Does not provide account-specific credentials, policies, architecture details, or production context.
Generated workflows require review and testing for each operating system, cloud, and application.
The source does not require confirmation before privileged or production changes.

use_cases.title: Standardize Service Deployment
use_cases.description: Prepare container, proxy, health-check, validation, and delivery steps for a repeatable service deployment.

use_cases.title: Investigate Production Incidents
use_cases.description: Organize read-only system, network, container, and application checks before proposing a controlled fix.

use_cases.title: Build Platform Workflows
use_cases.description: Plan Kubernetes resources, CI/CD stages, monitoring, alerts, backups, and operational documentation for an internal platform.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Container Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Docker Compose deployment for [service]. Include dependencies, storage, networking, health checks, secrets handling, validation, and rollback. Do not execute commands.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose High Server Load
prompt_templates.prompt: Help diagnose high load on [server type]. Start with read-only checks for CPU, memory, disk, network, and recent changes. Rank likely causes.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve a Kubernetes Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Kubernetes failure: [symptoms and outputs]. Identify the root cause, propose the smallest change, and define validation. Request approval before changes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Delivery System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a delivery system for [application and environment]. Cover infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, security, backups, failure recovery, approvals, and phased rollout.

output_examples.input: A Linux application server has sustained high load after a release.
output: Observation: resource saturation began after the latest deployment.
Next checks: inspect process usage, application logs, database latency, and deployment changes.
Proposed action: capture evidence, limit impact, and obtain approval before restarting or rolling back.

output_examples.input: A Kubernetes workload repeatedly enters CrashLoopBackOff.
output: Finding: the container exits because a required database setting is missing.
Recommendation: correct the secret reference, validate it in staging, and request approval for a rolling deployment.
Validation: watch readiness, restart counts, events, and logs after the approved change.

best_practices: Provide the environment, scope, symptoms, recent changes, constraints, and desired outcome.
Begin with read-only diagnostics and use dry runs before applying changes.
Require explicit approval, backups, validation criteria, and rollback steps for production changes.
anti_patterns: Do not place passwords, tokens, private keys, or unredacted secrets in prompts.
Do not run unreviewed commands with elevated privileges or against production systems.
Do not skip backups, staged testing, post-change validation, or operational records.

faq.question: Which operational areas does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring, troubleshooting, automation, security operations, backups, and disaster recovery.

faq.question: Can it execute commands in my environment?
faq.answer: A compatible agent may execute commands when tools allow it. Review permissions, scope, and every production change before approval.

faq.question: Does it support Kubernetes troubleshooting?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides pod inspection, log and event analysis, resource checks, corrective changes, and validation.

faq.question: Can it create monitoring configurations?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide Prometheus collection, alert rules, Grafana data sources, dashboards, and logging pipelines.

faq.question: Does it protect secrets automatically?
faq.answer: No. Users must redact credentials, use approved secret stores, restrict access, and review generated configurations.

faq.question: What should I provide for incident analysis?
faq.answer: Provide symptoms, timestamps, environment details, sanitized logs, metrics, recent changes, and business impact.
